verdict.rationale: Simular's evidence describes cloud computers and approval gates before sensitive steps, but nothing documents a sandbox or test environment that keeps agent work away from production data. Its cloud machines are isolated compute that still operate on real logged-in apps, and approvals are a human-in-the-loop control, not a dry-run or sandbox mode. The axis applies to an agent platform, so the absence of evidence makes this none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
